regimens.dose_text: Extended-release: Starting dose is 0.375 mg once daily. Titrate gradually no more frequently than every 5-7 days: Week 2: 0.75 mg/day; Week 3: 1.5 mg/day; Week 4: 2.25 mg/day; Week 5: 3 mg/day (max 4.5 mg/day). In immediate-release, dose is given TID (initial 0.125 mg TID up to max 1.5 mg TID).
